findings: Broad open Beads include substantial existing implementations; prioritization used current source and the plan's crash-safe evidence and resource requirements.
Every durable append cloned the entire reference ledger, including all prior full snapshots and batches, to avoid a semantic failure after journal publication.
An indeterminate append requires the exact validated successor to remain private until the original journal obligation is reconciled.
